text.p: Rexene Corp said Monday it will adjourn its stockholders meeting from April 30 to May 22 because the company has entered into a confidentiality agreement with Huntsman Corp.
Huntsman had said it hoped to acquire Rexene for $16 per share in cash.
The record date for the meeting will remain April 18, 1997, Rexene said.
Rexene also said it is extending the expiration date of its pending Dutch-auction tender offer for up to 2,156,250 shares of its common stock through May 29.
The offer had been scheduled to expire May 5, Rexene said.
As of the close of business on April 24, Rexene said about 197,000 shares had been validly tendered.
On April 22 Rexene said it would give privately-held Huntsman access to its non-public information as long as it signed a confidentiality agreement.
